{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}
parts.text: Suggest two functions of the copper braid.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest one application of a coaxial cable for the transmission of electrical signals.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
The constant noise power in a transmission cable is $7.6\,\mu\text{W}$. The minimum acceptable signal-to-noise ratio is $32\text{ dB}$.

Calculate the minimum acceptable signal power $P_{\text{MIN}}$ in the cable.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The input power of the signal to the transmission cable is $2.6\text{ W}$. The attenuation per unit length of the cable is $6.3\text{ dB km}^{-1}$.

Use your answer in (i) to determine the maximum uninterrupted length $L$ of cable along which the signal may be transmitted.
